Tuesday Night Loop

Tupelo, MS · Road

Tuesday Night Loop is a road group ride in Tupelo, MS. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:30 pm from St. Luke Methodist Church. About 25–30 miles, 16–25 mph depending on group.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 16–25 mph: fast — for riders who race or train. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Night Loop group ride

A weeknight road loop of 25 to 30 miles. Groups range from 16 mph to 25 mph average.
